newsitem.title: THAILAND: Small group of expats fleeing Cambodia by land.
newsitem.headline: Small group of expats fleeing Cambodia by land.

text.p: A small group of expatriates were fleeing fighting in Cambodia on Sunday and planned to cross the border into Thailand, diplomatic and immigration sources said.

"We understand that a small group of expatriates and NGO (non-government organisation) workers, including Australians, are travelling to Thailand via Battambang," a spokesman for Australia's Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade told Reuters by telephone from Canberra.
The nationalities of the other people in the group and their exact number was not known, he said.
"They are going with the assistance of the Australian defence attache who was in Battambang," he said. Battambang is in northwestern Cambodia near the Thai border.

Thai Immigration officials at the border town of Aranyaprathet, in eastern Thailand, told reporters that officials in Bangkok had told them a group of 17 expatriates from Phnom Penh had requested permission to pass through the checkpoint on Sunday afternoon.

The Phnom Penh airport has been closed since Saturday and most airlines serving Cambodia had suspended their flights due to fighting that has been going on in the capital since Saturday as troops loyal to the rival co-premiers battle for power.
